skill.name: workflow
skill.description: Guides complex coding tasks through planning, focused delegation, progress tracking, verification, and lesson capture.
skill.summary: Apply a structured workflow to plan, execute, verify, and improve complex coding tasks.
skill.author: brianlovin

content.value_statement: Complex coding tasks can lose structure across planning, implementation, and verification. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through a disciplined workflow.
actual_capabilities: Creates checkable plans for coding tasks with three or more steps.
Encourages focused subagent delegation for research and parallel analysis.
Tracks implementation progress in a task document.
Requires tests, logs, or behavioral comparisons before completion.
Captures lessons after user corrections to reduce repeated mistakes.
limitations: Does not provide language-specific implementation guidance.
Does not include scripts, test runners, or external integrations.
Relies on the active agent to create and maintain task files.
Cannot guarantee correctness when relevant tests or logs are unavailable.

use_cases.title: Plan a Multi-Step Feature
use_cases.description: Structure a feature into checkable implementation and verification steps before changing code.

use_cases.title: Resolve a Complex Defect
use_cases.description: Trace a reported defect through logs, tests, root-cause analysis, and a verified fix.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Repository Refactoring
use_cases.description: Delegate focused analysis while tracking a minimal refactor and its behavioral validation.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Task Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan this task with checkable steps: [task]. Include implementation, testing, and completion criteria before making changes.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate and Fix a Bug
prompt_templates.prompt: Investigate this bug: [bug report]. Identify the root cause, implement a focused fix, and verify the changed behavior.
prompt_templates.scenario: Resolving a defect with available logs or tests

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate a Refactor
prompt_templates.prompt: Refactor [component] to achieve [goal]. Plan focused analysis tasks, preserve behavior, minimize changed code, and document verification results.
prompt_templates.scenario: Improving architecture without changing expected behavior

prompt_templates.title: Execute a Complex Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Deliver [change] across [affected areas]. Create a detailed plan, delegate independent analysis, track progress, compare behavior, run validation, and capture lessons.
prompt_templates.scenario: Managing an advanced change across several repository areas

output_examples.input: Plan an authentication timeout change across the API and web client.
output: Map current timeout behavior and affected components.
Define API and client changes with compatibility checks.
Add focused tests for expiration and renewal behavior.
Compare previous and updated behavior before completion.

output_examples.input: Fix a failing CI test that passes locally.
output_examples.output: The workflow isolates environment differences, reproduces the failure, applies a focused fix, reruns relevant tests, and records the verification result.

output_examples.input: Refactor duplicated validation logic without changing behavior.
output_examples.output: The workflow inventories duplicate paths, defines preserved behavior, consolidates the logic, runs regression tests, and reviews the final change scope.

best_practices: Define observable completion criteria before implementation begins.
Assign each delegated analysis task one focused objective.
Use tests, logs, and behavior comparisons as verification evidence.
anti_patterns: Do not create a detailed workflow for a simple and obvious edit.
Do not mark tasks complete without concrete verification evidence.
Do not expand the change beyond the documented task scope.

faq.question: When should I use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it for tasks with several steps, architectural decisions, complex defects, or meaningful verification requirements.

faq.question: Does this skill write code?
faq.answer: It guides the active coding agent through execution, but it does not contain standalone implementation scripts.

faq.question: Does it require subagents?
faq.answer: No. Subagents are recommended when independent research or parallel analysis can improve focus.

faq.question: Which task files does it use?
faq.answer: It directs the agent to maintain tasks/todo.md and to record correction patterns in tasks/lessons.md.

faq.question: How does it verify results?
faq.answer: It asks the agent to run tests, inspect logs, compare behavior, and demonstrate correctness before completion.

faq.question: Can it handle simple edits?
faq.answer: Yes, but its detailed planning process is intended for non-trivial work and should not overcomplicate obvious changes.
